prompt: Give the bounded-activation account of the STEEL failure in your own words.
answer: LSTM, BiLSTM, GRU and LSTM-16 use sigmoid gates and tanh updates, so any one input's contribution is bounded. Self-attention and auto-correlation compute raw dot-product or correlation scores with no bound. A heavy-tailed value that survives Z-score standardisation can then dominate the mixed computation, producing exploding values consistent with NaN propagation. PatchTST computes attention only within each channel's patches, so an outlier cannot affect other channels.
